anomalies.description: A man in a cowboy hat engages in hand-to-hand combat with two men in suits inside a barrel-filled warehouse; he uses a long pole as a weapon and executes multiple strikes and takedowns.

A second fight erupts between the cowboy-hatted man and a bespectacled man; they struggle over a long object (possibly a rifle), culminating in the cowboy pointing a pistol at the other man while both are in close contact.

The man in the cowboy hat points a handgun directly at the suited man’s face; the gun is clearly visible and aimed, consistent with an imminent or just-occurred shot (no muzzle flash visible, but posture and proximity strongly indicate a shooting event).

A renewed physical struggle occurs: the man in the suit is thrown or falls backward, then grabs onto a wooden barrel while being attacked; the opponent swings a long object (possibly a rifle or pole), and the suited man ends up pressed against the barrel.
A standing person repeatedly strikes a prone individual on the floor in a wine cellar; the prone person remains motionless throughout, indicating helplessness.

Initial physical engagement between two individuals: one is on the ground while the other is in a dynamic posture suggesting active combat (e.g., kicking or striking), before the scene stabilizes into a clear abuse pattern.
